name: com.standardissuedata/vehicle-data
title: Standard Issue Data
description: Look up vehicle identity, safety, fuel economy, and recorded market history by VIN.

tools.name: lookup_vin
tools.description: Return VIN-pattern identity, model-level NHTSA recalls and complaints, configuration-level NHTSA crash ratings, EPA configurations, and exact-VIN listings, dated asking-price changes, and timestamped auction bids. A reviewed factory sticker total and seller-stated MSRP appear in separate fields when available. The public playground includes a saved confirmed-sale example for VIN WBSCD9321WEE08212. An account key includes closed-auction bids and source-confirmed sales for other covered VINs. The gearbox field shows listing evidence and conflicts with VIN-pattern decode. Source status explains missing or unavailable data.
